outcome: Placental histopathological alterations (villous fibrin deposits, thrombosis, intervillous hemorrhage, agglutination, avascular fibrotic villi, syncytial knots, villous infarction, fetal vascular malperfusion, chorioamnionitis)
cohort: The study included two groups of pregnant women (n=31 COVID-19 positive, n=31 COVID-19 negative) with similar demographic characteristics.
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 showed substantial placental histopathological alterations, a higher incidence of cesarean deliveries, and neonates with significantly lower birth weights compared to COVID-19 negative women.
mod_finding: The COVID-19 group had a higher incidence of cesarean deliveries, potentially due to concerns about maternal-fetal transmission and respiratory complications.
birth_weight: Neonates of COVID-19 positive mothers had significantly lower birth weights; specific values not provided.
